title: TIM ITIS Message Content
description: Validates normalized TIM ITIS message content.

oneOf.title: closed-to-traffic
oneOf.description: Matches the exact closed-to-traffic phrase token sequence and associated TIM metadata.

itis.description: Matches the exact closed-to-traffic phrase token sequence.

allowIndefinite.description: Road closure TIMs are expected to have a bounded active period.

geofence.description: Road closure TIMs are expected to be represented along a path.

oneOf.title: gross-weight-limit
oneOf.description: Matches a gross-weight-limit phrase and associated TIM metadata.

itis.description: Matches a gross-weight-limit phrase: opening token, variable weight value, and weight unit token.

allowIndefinite.description: Vehicle restriction TIMs may represent an indefinite standing restriction.

geofence.description: Vehicle restriction TIMs are expected to be represented along a path.

oneOf.title: speed-limit
oneOf.description: Matches a speed-limit phrase and associated TIM metadata.

itis.description: Matches a speed-limit phrase: speed-limit token followed by a variable speed value.

allowIndefinite.description: Speed-limit TIMs are expected to have a bounded active period.

geofence.description: Speed-limit TIMs are expected to be represented along a path.

oneOf.title: speed-unit-example
oneOf.description: Matches a phrase where the third token may be either miles-per-hour or kilometers-per-hour and associated TIM metadata.

itis.description: Matches a phrase where the third token may be either miles-per-hour or kilometers-per-hour.

items.description: Speed unit: miles per hour or kilometers per hour.

allowIndefinite.description: Speed-related TIMs are expected to have a bounded active period.

geofence.description: Speed-related TIMs are expected to be represented along a path.
